# Radio Button

A radio button lets users choose one option from a group of options. When they pick one, any previously selected option is deselected. Radio buttons are commonly used in forms and surveys when users need to pick just one choice from a list.

**Stylesheet:** `components/radio/radio.css`

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## 

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | — | Label text displayed next to the radio button. |
| `name` | `string` | — | Groups radio buttons so only one can be selected at a time. |
| `value` | `string` | — | The value submitted when this radio is selected. |
| `checked` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the radio button is selected. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Prevents user interaction. |
| `style` | `'primary' \| 'neutral'` | `'primary'` | Visual style — primary (green dot) or neutral (black dot). |
| `helper-text` | `string` | — | Descriptive text displayed below the label. |
| `alert-message` | `string` | — | Error or warning message with icon. |

## States

All interactive states — default, hover (move mouse over), disabled, and read-only.

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--spacing-md);">
    <p style="font-size: var(--font-size-xs); color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin-bottom: var(--spacing-xs);">Unselected</p>
    <label class="radio">
        <div class="radio__row">
            <div class="radio__control">
                <span class="radio__ripple"></span>
                <input type="radio" class="radio__input" name="states-unselected">
                <span class="radio__circle"></span>
            </div>
            <span class="radio__label">Default</span>
        </div>
    </label>
    <label class="radio radio--disabled">
        <div class="radio__row">

</div>
```

## With Helper Text

Descriptive text below the label provides additional context for each option.

```html
<div class="radio-group" style="max-width: 400px;">
    <label class="radio">
        <div class="radio__row">
            <div class="radio__control">
                <span class="radio__ripple"></span>
                <input type="radio" class="radio__input" name="helper-group" value="standard" checked="">
                <span class="radio__circle"></span>
            </div>
            <span class="radio__label">Standard delivery</span>
        </div>
        <span class="radio__helper">Free shipping. Arrives in 5-7 business days.</span>
    </label>
    <label class="radio">
        <div class="radio__row">
            <div class="radio__control">
                <span class="radio__ripple"></span>
                <input type="radio" class="radio__input" name="helper-group" value="express">
                <span class="radio__circle"></span>
            </div>
            <span class="radio__label">Express delivery</span>
        </div>
        <span class="radio__helper">SAR 25.00. Arrives in 1-2 business days.</span>
    </label>
    <label class="radio">
        <div class="radio__row">
            <div class="radio__control">
                <span class="radio__ripple"></span>
                <input type="radio" class="radio__input" name="helper-group" value="same-day">
                <span class="radio__circle"></span>
            </div>
            <span class="radio__label">Same-day delivery</span>
        </div>
        <span class="radio__helper">SAR 50.00. Available in select cities only.</span>
    </label>
</div>
```

## With Alert Message

Error or warning feedback displayed below a radio option.

```html
<div class="radio-group" style="max-width: 400px;">
    <label class="radio">
        <div class="radio__row">
            <div class="radio__control">
                <span class="radio__ripple"></span>
                <input type="radio" class="radio__input" name="alert-group" value="a">
                <span class="radio__circle"></span>
            </div>
            <span class="radio__label">Option A</span>
        </div>
        <span class="radio__helper">When a selection needs a further detailed explanation, it goes here.</span>
        <div class="radio__alert">
            <svg class="radio__alert-icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                <path d="M8 5.333V8m0 2.667h.007M14.667 8A6.667 6.667 0 1 1 1.333 8a6.667 6.667 0 0 1 13.334 0Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.333" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path>
            </svg>
            <span class="radio__alert-text">Error/Warning message</span>
        </div>
    </label>
    <label class="radio">
        <div class="radio__row">
            <div class="radio__control">
                <span class="radio__ripple"></span>
                <input type="radio" class="radio__input" name="alert-group" value="b" checked="">
                <span class="radio__circle"></span>
            </div>
            <span class="radio__label">Option B</span>
        </div>
        <span class="radio__helper">Additional context for option B.</span>
    </label>
</div>
```

## Radio Group

## RTL Layout

Right-to-left support for Arabic and other RTL languages.

```html
<div dir="rtl" style="width: 100%;">
    <div class="radio-group" style="max-width: 400px; margin-left: auto;">
        <label class="radio">
            <div class="radio__row">
                <div class="radio__control">
                    <span class="radio__ripple"></span>
                    <input type="radio" class="radio__input" name="rtl-group" value="a" checked="">
                    <span class="radio__circle"></span>
                </div>
                <span class="radio__label">عنوان اختيار مفرد</span>
            </div>
            <span class="radio__helper">يكتب المحتوى الإضافي هنا في حال ان عنوان الاختيار يحتاج الى شرح أو تفصيل.</span>
        </label>
        <label class="radio">
            <div class="radio__row">
                <div class="radio__control">
                    <span class="radio__ripple"></span>
                    <input type="radio" class="radio__input" name="rtl-group" value="b">
                    <span class="radio__circle"></span>
                </div>
                <span class="radio__label">خيار ثاني</span>
            </div>
            <span class="radio__helper">وصف إضافي للخيار الثاني.</span>
        </label>
        <label class="radio">
            <div class="radio__row">
                <div class="radio__control">
                    <span class="radio__ripple"></span>
                    <input type="radio" class="radio__input" name="rtl-group" value="c">
                    <span class="radio__circle"></span>
                </div>
                <span class="radio__label">خيار ثالث</span>
            </div>
            <span class="radio__helper">وصف إضافي للخيار الثالث.</span>
            <div class="radio__alert">
                <svg class="radio__alert-icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                    <path d="M8 5.333V8m0 2.667h.007M14.667 8A6.667 6.667 0 1 1 1.333 8a6.667 6.667 0 0 1 13.334 0Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.333" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path>
                </svg>
                <span class="radio__alert-text">رسالة خطأ أو تحذير</span>
            </div>
        </label>
    </div>
</div>
```
